summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo at the base commit, without committing and without running tests or code. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, internal TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard handling, click dispatch via range_clicked, and an animated _bar_position driven by watch__active_tab_name); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges before width and now yields one Text object with click spans last; Opacity merges its blended color into the existing style, preserving click metadata. Added docs/reference/tabs.md, new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (existing tests unchanged), and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py with __init__.py. The layout resolver needed no change because its Edge protocol already declares min_size and fraction. The sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Caveats: all tests are unverified because I did not run them; with duplicate tab names the full-list find_tab_by_name index and the displayed-tab bar position disagree, so the highlight can land on the wrong tab (the spec's wording conflicts here); search only applies to single-character keys.
